16:9 cinematic live-action dark fantasy.

Late sunset moving toward dusk.

Grounded realistic movement.

Natural cinematic camera movement.

Strong smoke, firelight, ash, and atmospheric depth.

Keep the sequence simple and visually readable.

No combat.

No subtitles.

No background music.


=== VIDEO SUMMARY ===

Riven has seen smoke rising from the direction of her home.

She is now desperately running back.

She races along the mountain road,
reaches the burning village,
and searches through the destruction for her father.

She does not find him yet.

The scene ends when Riven discovers something off-screen
near her family home and suddenly stops.


=== SCENES ===

Shot 1 — RUNNING HOME

CUT directly into motion.

Begin with a low close tracking shot
of Riven's boots running rapidly along the mountain road.

Do not begin with Riven standing still.

She is already running at full speed.

After several running steps,
the camera naturally pulls back
and reveals Riven.

She is exhausted, dirty, and emotionally shaken,
but she forces herself to keep running.

She carries her sword with her.

Far ahead,
large columns of dark smoke rise into the sky
from the direction of her home village.

Riven sees the smoke and runs even harder.


Shot 2 — ENTERING THE VILLAGE

Transition to Riven reaching the burning village.

She runs into the village
and immediately sees the scale of the destruction.

Buildings are burning.

Some roofs have collapsed.

Wooden structures are broken.

Thick smoke moves through the streets.

Ash drifts through the air.

Small fires burn among the debris.

The village feels devastated and almost completely empty.


Riven slows slightly as she looks around in disbelief.

She desperately calls:

"Father!"


No answer.


Riven continues deeper into the village.


Shot 3 — SEARCHING

Follow Riven as she moves quickly
through the ruined village.

She looks between burning houses
and searches the familiar paths around her.

Her breathing is heavy.

Her fear is growing.


Riven calls again, louder:

"Father!"


Still no answer.


She keeps moving toward the area of her family home.

Keep the environment around her damaged,
burning, smoky, and abandoned.

Do not show the cause of the destruction.

Do not reveal any creature.


Shot 4 — SOMETHING AHEAD

Riven reaches the area near her family home.

She moves through smoke and scattered debris.

Then she suddenly notices something ahead of her,
outside the camera frame.


Riven stops.


Do not reveal what she sees.


Stay on Riven.

Her expression changes.

Urgency gives way to shock and fear.

She stares at something off-screen ahead of her.


Hold briefly on Riven's reaction.


CUT.
